messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty triggered: service=inference-prod-p99 | condition=p99_latency > 1000ms (5m) | severity=page
pagerduty: Alert: inference-prod-p99 — runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-p99 | triggered at 11:02 UTC
priya_oncall: ack — Im taking this. tagging infra + runtime. grabbing dashboards. :wave:
alex_sre: on standby, will check node pools, autoscaler, and recent placement failures
lia_dev: Ill check model routing, KV cache, and any recent config push. any customer reports so far? @sam_support
sam_support: one customer DMed slower completions in eu-west, ticket #3899 created. CS notified. no 5xxs reported yet.
alex_sre: quick metric read: p99 climbed to ~1150ms at 11:04 UTC, queue length x4 on inference-eu pool. GPU util ~98% on some nodes
alex_sre: logs: "ScaleUp attempt failed: InsufficientGPUQuota" — looks like cluster hit regional quota, preventing autoscaler from adding new nodes
priya_oncall: runbook step: check fallback routing and model variants. can we divert some traffic to the quantized variant with lower memory footprint?
lia_dev: yes — v2-quant exists and has smaller GPU memory needs, p99 usually ~500-600ms but small accuracy delta. we can do % split at LB level.
priya_oncall: applying traffic split: `rbacctl route set inference-prod --split v1=85,v2-quant=15` — will watch
incident-bot: routing change applied by priya_oncall at 11:07 UTC
alex_sre: trying emergency quota bump with cloud provider; ETA unknown. also spinning up preemptible instances in eu-west as temporary capacity, initiating template update now
lia_dev: cache metrics: prefix-kv hit rate fell from 92% to 40% since 10:58 UTC — lots of cold misses on hot keys. starting cache-warm job for top 500 prefixes: `./tools/warm_prefixes --file top_prefixes.txt`
sam_support: updated CS ticket: customers experiencing higher latency, suggested retry/backoff as short-term workaround
priya_oncall: gateway mitigation: adding soft token limit to protect tail — `gatewayctl update --max-tokens 1500 --concurrency 8` (applied)
alex_sre: preemptible instances started provisioning, but one instance template hit image pull delay; workarounds in progress
lia_dev: noticed increased KV eviction churn — lowering eviction aggressiveness: set prefix_cache.lru_ttl=25m
alex_sre: new nodes registered at 11:13 UTC, pool utilization down to ~72%, queue draining
priya_oncall: p99 down to 610ms (11:15). still above alert threshold but trending down. keeping page active until stable for 5m
incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert acknowledged by priya_oncall, escalation paused
sam_support: customer follow-up: EU customer reports improvement but intermittent spikes remain; collecting request IDs for investigation
lia_dev: warming job completed, cache hit back up to 80% — good improvement on prefix misses
alex_sre: cloud approved temporary quota bump for eu-west; manual scale allowed. adding nodes to reserve for peak.
priya_oncall: reducing routing split to v1=95,v2-quant=5 to balance quality and latency — applied
priya_oncall: p99 steady at ~320ms for past 3 minutes, p95 ~110ms. queue back to normal.
priya_oncall: preparing mitigation summary and action items. will open postmortem ticket once we close this thread.
matt_oncall: acknowledged handoff request from priya_oncall — Ill pick up monitoring for the night. leave any outstanding tasks in the tracker.
priya_oncall: handing off to @matt_oncall — tasks: confirm quota increase persists, validate autoscaler healthcheck, follow up on runbook additions. thanks team :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident closed automatically at 11:26 UTC (metric below threshold). Post-incident task created: TASK-5018
priya_oncall: immediate action items noted: 1) add emergency quota bump step to runbook, 2) add automated warmup job before high-traffic windows, 3) evaluate LRU TTL default for prefix cache, 4) document routing policy for quality-sensitive endpoints
lia_dev: engineering action: create synthetic load to validate cache warming and eviction changes in staging before next deploy
alex_sre: infra action: request permanent increase for eu-west GPU quota and add a pre-provisioning buffer in autoscaler config
sam_support: CS action: compile customer impact summary and send to affected accounts, keep ticket #3899 updated
priya_oncall: thanks all. marking this thread mitigated and moving to postmortem.
